text_block_list.text:
Mooorning! Trainer-san!
After the break, let's get fired up!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
And so~,
I'll share a fortune that's perfect for getting pumped up!
Here goes~...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Yes! Look at the angle of my arms!!
It is the fortune of splitting disposable chopsticks relatively cleanly!!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Looks like we're gonna do pretty well in today's training too!
